note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a ETH 4-5; A06b ETH 4-5; L05 ETH 20): ordinary naturalisation after 4 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Ethiopia, 2024
sources.said: Person has been domiciled in Ethiopia for at least 4 years. ... Renunciation of citizenship of another country required. ... Person has voluntarily acquired citizenship of another country.
